newsitem.title: UK: Colombian Coporo oil field promising - minister.
newsitem.headline: Colombian Coporo oil field promising - minister.

text.p: Colombia's newly-discovered Coporo field so far shows promising results, with an estimated 700 million barrels of high quality crude oil reserves, but the exploration project has only just begun, the Colombian oil minister said on Monday.
"We estimate in this first phase there could be 700 million but this is just the beginning of the entire assessment," he told Reuters in an interview.

He agreed with geologists' estimates that it could contain as much as 1.3 billion barrels, but did not want to confirm this as a commercial figure before more work. "We have to be cautious because even if there are large reserves it depends on the formation if we can declare the field commercial," he said.
He said Ecopetrol had only drilled about 14,000 feet of the planned 18,000 foot Caporo well and hoped to make the biggest discovery at the greatest depth.
"We think the big one is down in Guadaloupe (the deepest layer)," he said. "The formation is ideal and very promising."
He said the oil was "just as good or even better than Cusiana oil."
